title: Role activation — first 30 days tactile checklist
content:
Purpose
This is a lightweight, tactile 0–30 day activation checklist for new hires (ICs and managers) designed to make ramping predictable and measurable. Focus is on tasks that unblock contribution and surface quick wins for both the new hire and their partner teams. Use as a baseline — teams should adapt where necessary.

How to use this doc
- Manager and mentor should review before offer acceptance and agree on a first-week plan.
- Copy into candidate folder and add role-specific tasks (product, infra, RLHF lab, etc.).
- Mark items DONE in Slack thread #people-ops-onboard and attach evidence links (PRs, docs, demos).

Quick wins goal (first 14 days)
- Merge a low-risk doc or config change (e.g., README, infra flag)
- Ship a minimal, observable change in a non-prod env (PR + review)
- Present a 10-minute readout on Day 10: what I learned, blockers, plan

Week 0 (pre-start — before first day)
- [ ] Offer packet signed and payroll/KYC completed (TA)
- [ ] Hardware requested and tracked (IT ticket)
- [ ] Slack account created and invited to #team, #onboard, #people-ops-onboard
- [ ] Assign mentor (peer) and schedule 1:1s (mentor + manager + buddy)
- [ ] Share role one-pager with hire: expectations, success signals, 30/60/90 outcomes

Day 1–3 (orientation & context)
- [ ] Access check: corp email, Okta, VPN, gating tools, GitHub, Jira, Confluence, cloud console
- [ ] Quick infra tour: key repos, deployment runbooks, staging/preview flow (15–30m demo)
- [ ] Security checklist completed: MFA, KMS access request started if needed
- [ ] Team standups, channels, recurring meetings added to calendar
- [ ] Walkthrough of primary product/feature the hire will own (owner-led 30m)
- Notes to self: new hires often miss the internal CLI token step — add to pre-start checklist.

Days 4–10 (low-risk delivery, signals)
- [ ] Small onboarding task assigned (bugfix, doc, infra toggle) with acceptance criteria and reviewer
- [ ] Merge PR with at least one approve and CI green in non-prod
- [ ] Conduct first 30-min asynchronous readout in team channel (what I did, learned, blockers)
- [ ] Mentor-run peer shadow session on code review + deployment flow
- [ ] Schedule 1:1 weekly recurring with manager + mentor cadence established

Days 11–20 (ramp & integration)
- [ ] Owner for a microcycle task: write spec, get feedback, iterate, and demo
- [ ] Create or update a runbook or diagnostic checklist for the area owned
- [ ] Validate access for any dependent services (KMS, DB, metrics)
- [ ] Pair on an oncall rotation shadow if role touches SRE: read alerts, runbook steps
- Unresolved question: confirm whether Dedicated capacity onboarding requires the extra KMS sign-off — who owns this? (action: manager)

Days 21–30 (independent delivery & metrics)
- [ ] Deliver a scoped feature or optimization with owner-level responsibility (end-to-end PR, review, merge, deployment to staging)
- [ ] Present a 10–15 minute demo to cross-functional partners (product, QA, infra) — record for future hires
- [ ] Publish a short post-mortem or lessons-learned doc for onboarding task (one-pager in Confluence)
- [ ] Manager completes 30-day calibration: rate readiness (onboarding-ready | needs-more-scope | blocked)
- Ramp success metrics (suggested): at least 1 merged PR, documented runbook, mentor feedback score >= 3/5, able to describe service topology and deploy flow

Manager checklist (practical nudges)
- [ ] Set expectations upfront — share 30/60/90 with measurable examples
- [ ] Book 30/60/90 check-ins on calendar and block focus time for pair-programming
- [ ] Ensure mentor has protected time and clear goals for the first two weeks
- [ ] Triage access blockers immediately — escalate to SRE or Infra owner if >24h
- [ ] Signal to team: what the new hire will own, where to route questions, and who is backup

Mentor checklist (day-to-day)
- [ ] Shadow PR reviews together for first 2 weeks
- [ ] Run-through of typical oncall/debugging scenarios (10–20m)
- [ ] Share personal cheat-sheet: common CLI commands, useful dashboards, quick-win ideas
- [ ] Give continuous feedback — 15m twice-weekly touchpoints first 2 weeks

Interview evidence mapping (how we know skills match role)
- Sourcing -> Interview -> Onboard mapping examples:
  - Architecture prompt in onsite -> candidate wrote simple design doc -> onboard goal: own a small design + doc (evidence: merged design doc)
  - Debugging pair exercise -> candidate found root cause in 30m -> onboard goal: troubleshoot and close a real bug (evidence: PR + incident note)
  - Culture/values rubric -> candidate showed cross-team collaboration -> onboard goal: run a cross-functional demo (evidence: demo recording + feedback)

Common onboarding traps and mitigations
- Trap: delayed infra access -> Mitigation: pre-request keys + a single escalation owner (SRE liaison)
- Trap: vague first task -> Mitigation: always assign a task with a PR-style acceptance criteria and a reviewer
- Trap: mentor overloaded -> Mitigation: rotate shadow slots across mentors and protect 1 hour/week for onboarding

Templates / copy snippets (use in offer/candidate comms)
- Welcome email snippet: "Welcome to Redwood — your first week will focus on access, a small code task, and a 10-minute team readout. Your mentor is {mentor}. Please check the pre-start tasks linked here: {link}."
- Manager 30-day calibration prompt: "Rate readiness 1–5, highlight blockers, top 2 next priorities, mentor feedback summary."

TODO (open items)
- [ ] Finalize standard microtask repo with labels: onboarding, low-risk, mentor-approved (owner: DevPlatform)
- [ ] Decide whether we require recorded Day 10 readout for all ICs (pros/cons)
- [ ] Confirm Dedicated onboarding KMS gating flow with infra-security (owner: Daniel Kim)

Appendix: example microtask (copyable)
Title: fix stale README link + add 'dev run' quick command
Description: update broken link in README for local dev and add a short CLI command in doc to run the service locally. Add validation steps and a test to CI as appropriate.
Acceptance criteria:
- PR with description, 1 reviewer, CI green
- README link fixed + dev run snippet added
- Short PR comment referencing onboarding ticket
Estimated time: 60–120m

Last notes (informal)
- This doc should be pruned each quarter; capture recurring blocker patterns and move mitigations into the People Ops playbook.
- Feedback welcome — copy edits, additional templates, or role-specific tweaks.
- Quick wins are morale wins — celebrate small merges in team standup.
